name: model-block-render-last
title: 模型方块最后渲染选项（Blockbuster render-last 移植）
description: Port Blockbuster's render-last model block option to BBS FSR (new). Blocks flagged render-last skip the normal BE pass, collect into a frame queue, and replay at the AFTER_ENTITIES stage sorted far-to-near so models behind translucent model blocks stay visible.
creator: snowstar_II
